# v0.3.0 — Verified RTU replies and bounded diagnostics

This release checks that Modbus replies actually match the requested operation
and adds a small event history to diagnostic downloads. The minimum remains
**Home Assistant 2026.9.0**.

## Charging reliability

Replies with the wrong function, register address, echoed value or register
count no longer count as successful writes. An uncertain write keeps its
five-second current-register cooldown and is never retried automatically.
Reads retain their bounded retry budget and release the bus for the heartbeat.

Tests exercise fragmented, corrupt, truncated, foreign-device and delayed RTU
frames through the real serial library. RTU has no transaction identifier;
indistinguishable stale replies remain a protocol limitation. Physical-wallbox
validation remains outstanding.

## Diagnostics and database load

Diagnostic downloads now include the last **40 runtime events**, covering
connection changes, heartbeat failures/recovery and rejected writes. Entries
contain relative times and predefined event names, with no raw exception text
or device paths. The history stays in RAM, resets on reload and creates no
additional entity attributes or Recorder state updates.

Repeated HA lifecycle tests check memory, tasks, timers, listeners, clients and
serial file descriptors. The 30-cycle resource run leaves no owned tasks,
listeners, clients or serial descriptors behind. This is a bounded test, not a
multi-day or disk-full soak. Existing [Recorder guidance](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.3.0/docs/recorder.md)
still applies; the integration does not impose a database size cap.

## Compatibility and release checks

PRs and releases validate **minimum HA + latest stable HA**, currently
**2026.9.0 and 2026.10.4**. The beta check runs separately during weekly/manual
maintenance. These checks do not open routine dependency PRs.

Published assets are checked against the approved Git commit, checksums,
metadata and SPDX SBOM. A read-only privacy audit checks public GitHub text and
release assets without reproducing matched values in its report.

## Updating

Existing **0.2.x** entries, devices, entity IDs and automations can be kept.
Upgrading from **0.2.3** needs no config-entry or blueprint migration. For older
versions, follow the existing [blueprint update instructions](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.3.0/docs/blueprints.md#updating-existing-blueprint-automations).
The separate [domain migration](https://github.com/memphi2/ha-mennekes-amtron/blob/v0.3.0/docs/upgrading.md)
still applies when upgrading from **0.1.0**.

One installation archive serves HACS and the Marketplace:
**`ha-mennekes-amtron.zip`**. Checksums, build metadata and an SPDX SBOM accompany
it. The domain remains **`mennekes_amtron_rtu`**.
